nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Pure High-Potency 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid Serum

avis.texte: This product caused tiny pimples and 1/8" blisters, as well as random other red spots i can't categorize. I have sensitive skin, but even one application pet week is too much for me.

I used this for a few days and it caused redness, itchiness and flaking. It's been a week since I stopped using it and my face is still a mess (and I'm a little concerned about it). I've never used a product that damaged my skin, so I wouldn't even say my skin is sensitive.
This serum along with the kiehl moisterizer left my skin very dehydrated and flacky. I would not recommend if you have dry and sensitve skin
Absolutely love this serum. Does exactly as it claims. I am new to Kiehls products but I'm so impressed!!
Absolutely love this serum. Does exactly as it claims. I am new to Kiehls products but I'm so impressed!!
I was having issues with my skin, dry dull and the associate recommended this serum. I'm in my second bottle liove!!

I was on Accutane for the first month and had a lot of dryness. I was told to use this, it'll help. I tried it along with another moisturizer that I use. It's amazing. Made my skin less dry and just soft and plump. Love it! Ps: I have bought and tried so many products before I finally tried this one. I've spent from like $6 up to $300. Nothing seem to work for me. Trust me, this is worth it. I understand everyone's face is different but this is the product that seem to work for me.

I'm on my third bottle of this and I just love how simple it is to add to my nighttime skincare routine. I use tret at night and I started incorporating a hyaluronic acid serum to help my skin not be super dry due to the retinol. I love that this dries down quickly and my skin is able to absorb this when it's still a bit damp from washing it. I was previously using skin ceticuls but couldn't justify the price for that serum so I'm happy I found this instead!
bought 2 i'm so in love with this stuff! my face feels absolutely incredible!
Noticeably smoother skin when applied each evening. Would love to maintain the same appearance throughout the day.
Seems good. I did not react poorly but have been using the serum first before I use this daily.

I am only a month into Accutane, and as we all know it causes DRYNESS and BURNING. I was browsing a skincare website and found this as the top serum to use during Accutane. I see why. It has brought my skin back to life and has hydrated it, lessening the burning sensation. This product never burned my skin even in the beginning and I saw results quickly. If you're on Accutane, GET THIS. It will save you.

Wow, I live in AZ and my skin is so dry. I use great moisturizers with Hyaluronic Acid but this amazing serum takes my skin to a whole new level. I apply the serum right after I cleanse and spray Avene thermal water on my face and then I apply my moisturizer. This serum is amazing.
this is the best hyaluronic serum on the market! doesn't feel sticky and keeps my skin so hydrated. i use it morning and night and love it so much!

avis.titre: Great item to add into your skincare routine.
avis.texte: I was in the market for a new face serum. I fell in love with this product from Kiehl's. The serum hydrates the face and smooths out the skin. The formula feels light as well. It works best if you combine it with other products like moisturizer. I personally bought this product at BlueMercury and it was reasonably priced at 35 bucks. I am definitely a happy customer... Prioritizing skin health without breaking the bank.

avis.titre: I can see the difference in her skin and I'm a man
avis.texte: Within 4-5 days of use I could see my mothers improvement in skin texture looking more moisturized and softer than with moisturizer alone. A definite visible improvement!!
This is probably one of the best moisturizers i have ever used. It is lightweight, doesn't cause breakouts, leaves my skin feeling hydrated and fresh. Definitely my go to!
It does not appear to be helping deeper wrinkles. Better to use this before wrinkles appear. I've been using for several months.
Excellent serum. Cool texture, most importantly easy to apply, absorbs quickly. I love this brand for its light scents and for the fact that cosmetics are working!

You should see results over time. I'm not exactly sure all the results I'm seeing as I'm pairing this with a lot of products for my acne but I don't have anything negative to say about it. It feels nice on the skin as well!

Amazing product ! It isn't super sticky like some can be and is great for dry skin in the winter ! It doesn't have a scent and it's the usual compact packaging that I love from kiels . The cost is also not to bad either !
I've been using this for a few months and it's become a staple in my daily routine. Goes on smooth and can definitely see a difference in my skin
This is a "must" for me. My skin just loves it! I haven't had any skin issues since I started using it about half a year ago.
I use the glycolic acid and the niacinamide which both have hylauronic acid in them so I don't feel like the use of this made a huge difference but my skin Is definitely more moisturized and hydrated

Kiehl's Ultra Pure High Potency 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a game-changer in the world of skincare. Let's talk about the price first – it's a fantastic value for what you get. This serum offers high-quality hyaluronic acid at a reasonable price point, making it accessible to a wide range of skincare enthusiasts. Now, the smell – it's practically scent-free, which is a big plus for those who prefer fragrance-free skincare products. This serum won't overwhelm your senses, allowing you to focus on the results it delivers. Speaking of benefits, where do I even begin? The 1.5% hyaluronic acid concentration is a powerful hydrating punch. It plumps and revitalizes your skin, leaving it feeling incredibly soft and smooth. It's a moisture magnet, effectively quenching your skin's thirst and improving its overall texture. Fine lines and wrinkles? They seem to fade away over time with consistent use. In summary, Kiehl's Ultra Pure High Potency 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a must-have in your skincare routine. It's affordable, scent-free, and delivers remarkable hydrating benefits that will leave your skin looking and feeling fabulous. Say goodbye to dry skin, and say hello to a radiant, youthful complexion with this fantastic serum. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Best Hyaluronic I used, after trying 4 brands!
avis.texte: It gives you that dewy and hydrated look when applied properly. And price point is not bad!
Absolutely hooked on this product. My face and neck appear dewy and supple. My skin feels very soft and pliable.
This serum is good and doesn't breakout my skin. It's sensitive skin approved.
A great HA serum! Helps mousturize and plump up your skin. I always feel like I have glass skin after using it. Only downside is my hair sticks to my face if you consider it one.

According to Kiehl's rep, my skin lacked hydration so she recommended this. And I love it. I love this brand and this serum did not disappoint. Very plumped and hydrate and the serum form is very easy to apply and absorb into the skin. Love it

The hyaluronic acid seriously helps my skin moisturize and prevents wrinkles. It's absorbed very quickly and there's no greasiness or stickiness. My skin is very sensitive and very dry, but this formulation goes on like silk and keeps my face well hydrated all day. Love it!
Such an amazing product I use it all the time and I notice a huge difference in my skin appearance

avis.titre: This product brightens and pumps my skin!
avis.texte: Love this stuff! Leaves my skin so hydrated. I use it at night before bed. Been 2 months and I'm very satisfied with results so far!
Have only used a few times, too soon to tell. Nice generous sample size.
Very happy with this hyaluronic acid serum. It is thick and hydrating without leaving me feeling sticky. Will be repurchasing in the future.

I've been using it for about a month now, I think the product is decent, but I'm still not blown away. The results have been minimal. I think this paired with the Kiehls night serum is the real way to go!
Been used this serum for a few weeks now. I see no impact. Think I'll save my money of this one
This product also did not work for me! My skin broke after the use.
got lots of small pimples and i contacted to get a refund but was never called back

Have tried other hyaluronic acid serums by other makers in the past, and they always seemed to dry out my skin. This one doesn't seem drying and my skin does look a bit more hydrated. I have only been using a few weeks but think I see a difference.
I tried this new serum and it caused me to breakout. All other products I ordered I love!
Love this product. Goes great with Botox. Use it morning and night.
Absorbed easily. Moisturizing!!! I use twice a day regularly.

I have used other hyaluronic acids and was out of my usual, thought I would try yours. It made my face feel dry and itchy plus being bright red. I stopped using it for a week thinking it might be something else. I used it again last night and I woke up to my face burning and feeling chapped. I couldn't recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.
Great serum that is absorbed and works quickly. A little goes a long way, and moisturizes like crazy!

Just bought this product today. Cleaned my face and applied it, immediately I noticed my skin peeling or flaking not a lot but I noticed it. I dont know if this is suppose to happen I also used moisturizer on my face after i used the serum please let me know it is not burning my skin or anything like that just noticed some flaking or peeling
I've used a lot of brands Hyaluronic Acid and this is by far the best I've used. My skin showed immediate improvement after a week of use. I will definitely reorder.

This serum worked wonders on my skin, made it feel soft &plump &looked so smooth &fresh. I did notice a difference on my forehead wrinkles, it smoothed them out &made them less noticeable. I am so happy to be able to add this product into my skincare routine. I use it 2/3 times a week &it works wonders. Legit magic in a bottle !!!! (I have used it for 2 months &see noticable results)

avis.titre: Doesn't play well with SPF but otherwise great
avis.texte: I find this pills any SPF I use, even after letting it dry. Otherwise, it feels nice on my skin and like a shot of moisture. I definitely love using it at night to help me wake up fresh and not dry. Highly recommend it- another great product from Kiehl's! I love how few ingredients it has as well.

This was my first time.using a Kiehl's product. I must say, I am rather impressed. The Kiehl's Ultra-Pure High-Potency Serum with 1.5 % Hyaluronic Acid is a game changer. My face looks & feels more hydrated. Best of all, I can see the plumpness it brings. Plus, I really like the texture.
Made my skin feel tight and less hydrated than before I put it on.

The texture is a bit sticky, but it is normal because it is hyaluronic acid, and it is not sticky after drying. There is no smell and the ingredients are very hydrating and have the effect of improving the top layer of the skin. I usually use it before any face cream, a few drops, once in the morning and once in the evening. It may be easy to rub on skin with makeup during the day, I would recommend using it more at night.
Love this serum. It keeps my skim super hydrated especially in the winter. I put this on damp skin and underneath my lotions and it gives me glowing skin!

avis.titre: A great serum for combination skin stype
avis.texte: I'm applying the new skincare routine by using fewer products but highly effective for my skin. This new serum came at the right time. It helps my skin stay hydrated for a longer time during the day. It absorbs pretty quickly into the skin that I really appreciate as I don't like the sticky feeling on my face.

If you're looking to spice up your skincare routine, look no further! This serum made my face so smooth, and full of live again! My skin was bouncey and felt like the elasticity was restored. I would definitely recommend this product if you're looking to bring life back to your face.

This stuff is amazing! I have really dry skin and struggle to keep my skin hydrated. I have been spraying my face with water and using this on top to lock in the moisture before I use moisturizer and it has worked wonders. You don't need a lot of this product, which really makes it cost-effective. I use it in the morning and at night and have seen a major difference in how plump and juicy my skin looks and feels. When I wear it under make up it does not pill or make anything slide around. Highly recommend if you have dry skin!

I tested out the product 3 weeks prior this review to ensure an honest response. This serum made my skin feel so so so rejuvenated, moisturized, and incredibly soft! It did take a good week to start noticing anything applying as instructed, but well worth in the long run. Cons - bottle is quite small for price.
I like how spreadable this is, although it does take a little bit to sink in as does all HA serums do. It adds more hydration to my skin and my skin has been feeling more bouncy.
This is a great serum! I love using it at night alongside my Tretinoin for an added boost of moisture.

I love hyaluronic acid, especially under my makeup to keep my dry skin plump and moisturized throughout the day. I typically apply in the morning and at night after my toner or essence dries. I will get my face a little damp and apply the serum. It has a nice, thicker consistency that is mildly sticky but is beautiful under makeup! The bottle looks and feels high end and I will definitely repurchase.

I really like this product. The serum is concentrated hyaluronic acid and works so well. I have noticed an improvement in my skin. I live in harsh winter weather and normally get very dry skin. This product has helped my skin not be dry. It keeps my skin so moisturized!! The texture is very nice as you would expect from a serum. I would recommend this product.
I have dry skin and this has helped a lot, I use it before my serum and I feel like I have seen a noticeable difference in the hydration of my skin

I used this serum at night time after I cleansed and toned my skin, it left my face feeling soft and smooth. The hydraulic acid is definitely my favorite active ingredient in this product and I think it makes or breaks certain skincare products. Will definitely purchase in the future and highly recommend!
In comparison to other brands I used I would definitely recommend. As an avid kiehls user this is exactly what I needed.

I have been using this after I shower on my face to add some hydration back. It does the trick for that for sure but does leave a little sticky. I also think the dropper function could be improved, it is a little stiff and doesn't get as much product as easily as I'd like.

I love hyaluronic acid, especially under my makeup to keep my dry skin plump and moisturized throughout the day. I typically apply in the morning and at night after my toner or essence dries. I will get my face a little damp and apply the serum. It has a nice, thicker consistency that is mildly sticky but is beautiful under makeup! The bottle looks and feels high end and I will definitely repurchase.
too soon to tell if this is working or not. so far i haven't noticed any difference in my skin with using this serum.

This is a lightweight but hydrating serum. It's thicker than I thought it would be, based on more watery hyaluronic acid serums I've used in the past. It spreads really easily and dries down pretty fast. No smell, which I appreciate. I like to use this by itself on no makeup days since it doesn't leave my skin too shiny, or underneath a moisturizer for extra hydration. It hasn't clogged my pores or broke me out so I'll be using it as a regular part of my routine.

I love this serum! It doesn't dry my skin out, it's fragrance free. My skin is super sensitive and this serum doesn't irritate my skin or cause any redness. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and healthy

I have not tried many products from the Kiehl's brand but I would say the quality is something that surprised me. The container itself is glass and along that the dropper is glass. I thought it was cool that the dropper was glass. The hyaluronic acid keeps my skin hydrated. I use it after toning and before any other serums and moisturizer. My skin has been dry from the weather and this serum has helped keep it hydrated. I believe the serum will last me past the winter season too.
I liked, its ok but is jothing that other products didn't do before. so I would propably pass on it. the price may change things.
Putting this serum under my moisturizer makes a big difference. The packaging is simple and easy to use. It really increases the ability of my skin to retain moisture.
I like that the product gets absorbed into my skin pretty quick. It doesn't smell bad nor is it sticky which I am in favor of. So far my skin feels pretty hydrated.
My sensitive and dry skin likes this product! I still need a heavier moisturizer on top of this serum but it's a really nice under moisturizer hydration serum! A little goes a long way.

My skin gets really dry with temperature changes and lately it's been painfully dry. This serum goes on so smoothly it practically glides and my skin drinks it up! I've been using it in both my morning and nighttime skincare routines and my skin feels amazing and looks so bright and happy! Will be getting another.

This hyaluronic acid hydrates my skin like no other product. leaves my skin very soft. I love this product and would recommend it to my friends because it works and leaves my skin beautiful. I have acne-prone skin and this product does not remove any more pimples

I do like this product, I think it's a good product, the packaging is nice and it actually cleared my face up for me, but I did have to use it super sparingly. I have very sensitive skin and it burned a little bit, I felt like my face was very sun-sensitive for several days
Very good serum. I have been using it for the past two weeks it worked really well on my skin. My skin feels so soft and fresh
I have been loving this serum. It's making my face feel so soft, hydrated, and plump. I don't think I'll ever stop using it now.

Absolutely loved this moisturizer. I've never tried any product from the brand Kiehls but I am so amazed by this serum. At first my impression was that it was going to be oily and break my face out but instead it hydrated it so much. My skin gets so dry that I have skin just flake off which is so embarrassing but with this new product I can't moisturize my face without it getting so greasy. I love this product already and will be buying more and telling all of my friends!

This product works great after washing my face I applied the serum before I went to bed and the next morning my bigger pimples were significantly smaller and the smaller ones were completely gone. I will definitely be adding this to my routine 😌
Loved the kiehls hyaluronic acid serum. Went on smooth and not sticky whatsoever
This didn't break my out and I couldn't even feel it on my face. Will continue to use

I enjoyed sampling Kiehl's Ultra-Pure High-Potency Serum 1.5% Hyaluronic Acid. I used it for 2 weeks and it hydrated my dry skin, which is especially dry during the winter. I would say this serum is quite comparable to other hyaluronic acid serums. I have tried other hyaluronic serums and do favor the Korean beauty brands better as they are more hydrating and give me a glass skin effect. Overall the Kiehl's serum performed as intended and easily absorbed into my skin.

I've been using this as part of my evening routine for about a month now. I use cleanser, moisturizer, then this serum. It has helped my rosacea bumps substantially. The serum is very silky and soaks in quickly. There's a light scent, but not overpowering. This definitely helps with moisturizing in winter months when cream isn't enough.
This is the perfect combination for a serum. It's easy to use and the results show in a matter of time.

This Kiehl's Ultra-Pure High-Potency Serum Hyaluronic Acid is amazing! I absolutely love it! I love the consistency, it's not too liquidity and absorbs right into the skin. I also like that you can barely smell any kind of scent! After using it my skin looks well hydrated and plump!

I loved the consistency of this hyaluronic acid. It quickly absorbed and left my skin noticeably more plump and hydrated. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and have noticed a big difference in the texture of my skin. My makeup applies so much more smoothly and my skin looks a lot more supple -!: hydrated.

avis.titre: Super hydrating and feels so soothing.
avis.texte: This serum really works and makes my skin look and feel so plump and dewy! My skin absorbs it immediately, leaving it plump and hydrated in appearance. It's not oily or sticky and has a light clean smell to it. It is definitely my favorite serum so far this year!

I really like this hyaluronic acid serum. I prefer to apply it to damp skin, even though the directions say to use it on dry. It keeps my skin barrier nice & healthy, & I feel moisturized, glowing from within.

To start with this is an amazing hyaluronic acid that keeps my skin looking very nice. I have been using it for weeks now and I can really see a big difference on my skin. My face feels so smooth and healthy. I have dry skin and this have helped maintain my face hydrated. Overall I really recommend this serum

I've tried hyaluronic acid serums before but never had the level of moisture retention I've gotten with this one from Kiehl's. My skin looks noticeably healthier and plumper which gives it a brighter look overall. I use it twice a day, right after washing my face, which has given me the best moisture retention. I'm a convert, definitely going to purchase once it runs out as it's been a game changer especially since I use prescription tretinoin daily.
My facial skin feels supple after using it. Will continue using to see if it helps with my hyperpigmentation.

I was a little skeptical at first as hyaluronic acid sometimes burns my skin, but a few drops of This actually helped a whole lot with clearing! Gave one less star only because I did feel a bit sticky but overall definitely recommend!!

Definitely not my favorite hyaluronic acid serum. It feels super watery and I didn't see any improvement in my skin's dryness or dehydration after using it. I actually felt drier. I would recommend splurging on a better HA or just getting something cheap that is probably the same quality as this one.
If you are someone who is dry or looking for super hydrated glass skin this is incredible if you're oily then I'd probably avoid

This is a serum with a little thicker consistency than water which I kind of like. I've been having hormonal changes to my skin lately so I was a little concerned about how this was going to affect it and I had no sensitivity issues whatsoever. It has a nice almost gel like consistency. I will continue using it for hydration.

I love this kiehl's high potency hyaluronic acid. It's been the best addition to my skin care routine. Its helped my skin feel more hydrated and plump but also smooth. My skin looks and feels so much better. Easily applied, sometimes add it directly to my face or other times I mix it in with my moisturizer or uv protection
I love using this serum under my moisturizer! My skin feels so good and hydrated! I will keep this in my routine!
I really like this serum. I have sensitive skin so I started out using this only once a week, but I really like this. It is very moisturizing which is perfect for this time of year.

I really enjoy how this serum makes my skin feel. With 2-3 drops morning and night it leaves my skin feeling moisturized, but not greasy. Some hyaluronic acid serums don't absorb as quickly into my skin, leaving a need to wait for it to dry before continuing with my other skincare steps - Kiehl's hyaluronic acid does not, and I love it. Would definitely recommend.
I liked the feel this gave my skin but feel it could be improved.
Loooove the feeling of this serum on my skin. Does not feel sticky at all and leaves my skin feeling refreshed.
I've been using this product for a few weeks now and absolutely love it! Works amazing and is a very fair price
It was nice but I didn't feel as smooth or soft as it promised but I'm going to keep using it to see if I didn't use it long enough.

I have dry skin, especially around the mouth area. I needed a product that will penetrate deeper and give that hydration I desperately need. This product does that! I love that I can also apply in specific area easily. I pair this with my Kiehl's hydrating mask as well!
This is such a hydrating product. I love it and would buy in the future.

This is great addition to the Kiehl's family, I would use sparingly and make sure the product is absorbed into your skin before applying your moisturizer. My only complaint is the size in reference to the price, but of course it is Kiehl's.
Serum makes my skin feel so smooth. It's moisturizing with out the thick feeling.

I really enjoyed using this hyaluronic acid serum. It feels a bit thicker than some others I've used, but not sticky. I have very dry skin and my skin has felt so soft with no flakiness while using this product.

avis.titre: Enjoyed using this Kiehl's Hyaluronic Acid serum
avis.texte: I received this Hyaluronic Acid high potency serum from BzzAgent and Kiehl's recently for testing and review purposes. I have enjoyed using this serum and find it works comparably well and possibly better versus Hyaluronic Acid serums I have used from other brands before. It absorbs quickly and is easily and is extremely gentle and non irritating to my skin, without any kind of sting. It keeps my skin moisturized well throughout the day as well as visibly improving its overall tone/glow around a week in or so, from what I could see. I have combination skin and I am happy with how this product worked for me and would recommend this as a good Hyaluronic Acid serum product to others.

I was pleasantly surprised that I didn't have any skin irritation by this serum, as my skin can go into "overdrive" sometimes with hyaluronic acid. Overall, I really enjoyed this product as my skin was noticeably "plumped" and smoother, which was great for makeup application.

In the winter months my skin is begging for more hydration but I don't like the feel of a lot of moisturizer. I like that this serum has such a simple ingredient list. The glycerin and hyaluronic acid give my skin that boost of hydration it craves. I've been putting on a few drops under my moisturizer at night and using it as my only "moisturizer" during the day under my sunscreen and my skin looks more plump and hydrated without feeling bogged down.
I love this serum! It's lightweight and not sticky, unlike a lot of serums I've tried before. It also is moisturizing, which is a plus. Helps my skin look great.
I loved testing out the Kiel's serum! My face feels a lot more smoother and hydrated. This product went very well with my skincare routine
I've tried several different brands hyaluronic acid serums but this one stands out. It's not sticky, it's hydrating, it lasts throughout my day/night, and my skin feels super smooth afterwards.
